verses.textZh: 犹大王亚们的儿子约西亚在位的时候，耶和华的话临到希西家的玄孙、亚玛利雅的曾孙、基大利的孙子、古示的儿子西番雅。
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹大王亚们的儿子约西亚在位的时候，耶和华的话临到希西家的玄孙、亚玛利雅的曾孙、基大利的孙子、古示的儿子西番雅。
verses.textZhCuv: 当犹大王亚们的儿子约西亚在位的时候，耶和华的话临到希西家的玄孙，亚玛利雅的曾孙，基大利的孙子，古示的儿子西番雅。
verses.textEnNiv: The word of the Lord that came to Zephaniah son of Cushi, the son of Gedaliah, the son of Amariah, the son of Hezekiah, during the reign of Josiah son of Amon king of Judah:
verses.textEnEsv: The word of the Lord that came to Zephaniah the son of Cushi, son of Gedaliah, son of Amariah, son of Hezekiah, in the days of Josiah the son of Amon, king of Judah.
verses.textEnNkjv: The word of the Lord which came to Zephaniah the son of Cushi, the son of Gedaliah, the son of Amariah, the son of Hezekiah, in the days of Josiah the son of Amon, king of Judah.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord gave this message to Zephaniah when Josiah son of Amon was king of Judah. Zephaniah was the son of Cushi, son of Gedaliah, son of Amariah, son of Hezekiah.
verses.textEnNasb: The word of the Lord which came to Zephaniah son of Cushi, son of Gedaliah, son of Amariah, son of Hezekiah, in the days of Josiah son of Amon, king of Judah:
verses.textEn: The word of the Lord that came to Zephaniah son of Cushi, the son of Gedaliah, the son of Amariah, the son of Hezekiah, during the reign of Josiah son of Amon king of Judah:

verses.textZh: 耶和华说： "我必把万物从地上 完全除灭。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华说： "我必把万物从地上 完全除灭。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说： 我必从地上除灭万类。
verses.textEnNiv: "I will sweep away everything from the face of the earth," declares the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: "I will utterly sweep away everything from the face of the earth," declares the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: "I will utterly consume everything From the face of the land," Says the Lord;
verses.textEnNlt: "I will sweep away everything from the face of the earth," says the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: "I will completely remove all things From the face of the earth," declares the Lord.
verses.textEn: "I will sweep away everything from the face of the earth," declares the Lord .

verses.textZh: 耶和华说： "我必除灭人类、牲畜、 空中飞鸟、 海里的鱼。 我必使恶人跌倒， 我必把人类从地上剪除。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华说： "我必除灭人类、牲畜、 空中飞鸟、 海里的鱼。 我必使恶人跌倒， 我必把人类从地上剪除。
verses.textZhCuv: 我必除灭人和牲畜， 与空中的鸟、海里的鱼， 以及绊脚石和恶人； 我必将人从地上剪除。 这是耶和华说的。
verses.textEnNiv: "I will sweep away both man and beast; I will sweep away the birds in the sky and the fish in the sea— and the idols that cause the wicked to stumble." "When I destroy all mankind on the face of the earth," declares the Lord ,
verses.textEnEsv: "I will sweep away man and beast; I will sweep away the birds of the heavens and the fish of the sea, and the rubble with the wicked. I will cut off mankind from the face of the earth," declares the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: "I will consume man and beast; I will consume the birds of the heavens, The fish of the sea, And the stumbling blocks along with the wicked. I will cut off man from the face of the land," Says the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: "I will sweep away people and animals alike. I will sweep away the birds of the sky and the fish in the sea. I will reduce the wicked to heaps of rubble, and I will wipe humanity from the face of the earth," says the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: "I will remove human and animal life; I will remove the birds of the sky And the fish of the sea, And the ruins along with the wicked; And I will eliminate mankind from the face of the earth," declares the Lord.
verses.textEn: "I will sweep away both man and beast; I will sweep away the birds in the sky and the fish in the sea— and the idols that cause the wicked to stumble." "When I destroy all mankind on the face of the earth," declares the Lord ,

verses.textZh: 我必伸手攻击犹大， 攻击耶路撒冷所有的居民。 我必从这地方除掉巴力所余下的， 除掉拜偶像的祭司的名字， 以及耶和华的祭司；
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必伸手攻击犹大， 攻击耶路撒冷所有的居民。 我必从这地方除掉巴力所余下的， 除掉拜偶像的祭司的名字， 以及耶和华的祭司；
verses.textZhCuv: 我必伸手攻击犹大 和耶路撒冷的一切居民， 也必从这地方剪除所剩下的巴力， 并基玛林的名和祭司，
verses.textEnNiv: "I will stretch out my hand against Judah and against all who live in Jerusalem. I will destroy every remnant of Baal worship in this place, the very names of the idolatrous priests—
verses.textEnEsv: "I will stretch out my hand against Judah and against all the inhabitants of Jerusalem; and I will cut off from this place the remnant of Baal and the name of the idolatrous priests along with the priests,
verses.textEnNkjv: "I will stretch out My hand against Judah, And against all the inhabitants of Jerusalem. I will cut off every trace of Baal from this place, The names of the idolatrous priests with the pagan priests—
verses.textEnNlt: "I will crush Judah and Jerusalem with my fist and destroy every last trace of their Baal worship. I will put an end to all the idolatrous priests, so that even the memory of them will disappear.
verses.textEnNasb: "So I will stretch out My hand against Judah And against all the inhabitants of Jerusalem. And I will eliminate the remnant of Baal from this place, And the names of the idolatrous priests along with the other priests.
verses.textEn: "I will stretch out my hand against Judah and against all who live in Jerusalem. I will destroy every remnant of Baal worship in this place, the very names of the idolatrous priests—

verses.textZh: 就是那些在房顶上敬拜天上万象的， 那些敬拜耶和华， 指着他起誓，又指着玛勒公起誓的，
verses.textZhCnvs: 就是那些在房顶上敬拜天上万象的， 那些敬拜耶和华， 指着他起誓，又指着玛勒公起誓的，
verses.textZhCuv: 与那些在房顶上敬拜天上万象的， 并那些敬拜耶和华指着他起誓， 又指着玛勒堪起誓的，
verses.textEnNiv: those who bow down on the roofs to worship the starry host, those who bow down and swear by the Lord and who also swear by Molek,
verses.textEnEsv: those who bow down on the roofs to the host of the heavens, those who bow down and swear to the Lord and yet swear by Milcom,
verses.textEnNkjv: Those who worship the host of heaven on the housetops; Those who worship and swear oaths by the Lord, But who also swear by Milcom;
verses.textEnNlt: For they go up to their roofs and bow down to the sun, moon, and stars. They claim to follow the Lord , but then they worship Molech, too.
verses.textEnNasb: "And those who bow down on the housetops to the heavenly lights, And those who bow down and swear to the Lord, but also swear by Milcom,
verses.textEn: those who bow down on the roofs to worship the starry host, those who bow down and swear by the Lord and who also swear by Molek,

verses.textZh: 那些转离不跟从耶和华的， 不寻找耶和华， 也不求问他的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 那些转离不跟从耶和华的， 不寻找耶和华， 也不求问他的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 与那些转去不跟从耶和华的， 和不寻求耶和华也不访问他的。
verses.textEnNiv: those who turn back from following the Lord and neither seek the Lord nor inquire of him."
verses.textEnEsv: those who have turned back from following the Lord , who do not seek the Lord or inquire of him."
verses.textEnNkjv: Those who have turned back from following the Lord, And have not sought the Lord, nor inquired of Him."
verses.textEnNlt: And I will destroy those who used to worship me but now no longer do. They no longer ask for the Lord ’s guidance or seek my blessings."
verses.textEnNasb: And those who have turned back from following the Lord, And those who have not sought the Lord nor inquired of Him."
verses.textEn: those who turn back from following the Lord and neither seek the Lord nor inquire of him."

verses.textZh: 你要在主耶和华面前肃静！ 因为耶和华的日子临近了， 因为耶和华已经预备了祭物， 把自己所请来的人分别为圣。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要在主耶和华面前肃静！ 因为耶和华的日子临近了， 因为耶和华已经预备了祭物， 把自己所请来的人分别为圣。
verses.textZhCuv: 你要在主耶和华面前静默无声， 因为耶和华的日子快到。 耶和华已经预备祭物， 将他的客分别为圣。
verses.textEnNiv: Be silent before the Sovereign Lord , for the day of the Lord is near. The Lord has prepared a sacrifice; he has consecrated those he has invited.
verses.textEnEsv: Be silent before the Lord God ! For the day of the Lord is near; the Lord has prepared a sacrifice and consecrated his guests.
verses.textEnNkjv: Be silent in the presence of the Lord God; For the day of the Lordis at hand, For the Lord has prepared a sacrifice; He has invited His guests.
verses.textEnNlt: Stand in silence in the presence of the Sovereign Lord , for the awesome day of the Lord ’s judgment is near. The Lord has prepared his people for a great slaughter and has chosen their executioners.
verses.textEnNasb: Be silent before the Lord God! For the day of the Lord is near, Because the Lord has prepared a sacrifice, He has consecrated His guests.
verses.textEn: Be silent before the Sovereign Lord , for the day of the Lord is near. The Lord has prepared a sacrifice; he has consecrated those he has invited.

verses.textZh: "到了我耶和华献祭的日子， 我必惩罚首领和王子， 惩罚所有穿外族衣服的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: "到了我耶和华献祭的日子， 我必惩罚首领和王子， 惩罚所有穿外族衣服的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 到了我－耶和华献祭的日子， 必惩罚首领和王子， 并一切穿外邦衣服的。
verses.textEnNiv: "On the day of the Lord ’s sacrifice I will punish the officials and the king’s sons and all those clad in foreign clothes.
verses.textEnEsv: And on the day of the Lord ’s sacrifice— "I will punish the officials and the king’s sons and all who array themselves in foreign attire.
verses.textEnNkjv: "And it shall be, In the day of the Lord’s sacrifice, That I will punish the princes and the king’s children, And all such as are clothed with foreign apparel.
verses.textEnNlt: "On that day of judgment," says the Lord , "I will punish the leaders and princes of Judah and all those following pagan customs.
verses.textEnNasb: "Then it will come about on the day of the Lord’s sacrifice That I will punish the princes, the king’s sons, And all who clothe themselves with foreign garments.
verses.textEn: "On the day of the Lord ’s sacrifice I will punish the officials and the king’s sons and all those clad in foreign clothes.

verses.textZh: 到那日，我必惩罚所有跳过门槛的， 所有使强暴和欺诈充满主人房屋的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 到那日，我必惩罚所有跳过门槛的， 所有使强暴和欺诈充满主人房屋的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 到那日，我必惩罚一切跳过门槛、 将强暴和诡诈得来之物充满主人房屋的。
verses.textEnNiv: On that day I will punish all who avoid stepping on the threshold, who fill the temple of their gods with violence and deceit.
verses.textEnEsv: On that day I will punish everyone who leaps over the threshold, and those who fill their master’s house with violence and fraud.
verses.textEnNkjv: In the same day I will punish All those who leap over the threshold, Who fill their masters’ houses with violence and deceit.
verses.textEnNlt: Yes, I will punish those who participate in pagan worship ceremonies, and those who fill their masters’ houses with violence and deceit.
verses.textEnNasb: "And on that day I will punish all who leap on the temple threshold, Who fill the house of their lord with violence and deceit.
verses.textEn: On that day I will punish all who avoid stepping on the threshold, who fill the temple of their gods with violence and deceit.

verses.textZh: 耶和华说： "到那日， 必有呼叫的声音从鱼门发出来， 必有哀号从新区发出来， 必有崩裂巨响从山间发出来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华说： "到那日， 必有呼叫的声音从鱼门发出来， 必有哀号从新区发出来， 必有崩裂巨响从山间发出来。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说：当那日， 从鱼门必发出悲哀的声音， 从二城发出哀号的声音， 从山间发出大破裂的响声。
verses.textEnNiv: "On that day," declares the Lord , "a cry will go up from the Fish Gate, wailing from the New Quarter, and a loud crash from the hills.
verses.textEnEsv: "On that day," declares the Lord , "a cry will be heard from the Fish Gate, a wail from the Second Quarter, a loud crash from the hills.
verses.textEnNkjv: "And there shall be on that day," says the Lord, "The sound of a mournful cry from the Fish Gate, A wailing from the Second Quarter, And a loud crashing from the hills.
verses.textEnNlt: "On that day," says the Lord , "a cry of alarm will come from the Fish Gate and echo throughout the New Quarter of the city. And a great crash will sound from the hills.
verses.textEnNasb: "And on that day," declares the Lord, "There will be the sound of a cry from the Fish Gate, Wailing from the Second Quarter, And a loud crash from the hills.
verses.textEn: "On that day," declares the Lord , "a cry will go up from the Fish Gate, wailing from the New Quarter, and a loud crash from the hills.

verses.textZh: 玛革提施的居民哪！你们要哀号， 因为所有的商人都灭亡了； 所有称银子的都被剪除了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 玛革提施的居民哪！你们要哀号， 因为所有的商人都灭亡了； 所有称银子的都被剪除了。
verses.textZhCuv: 玛革提施的居民哪，你们要哀号， 因为迦南的商民都灭亡了！ 凡搬运银子的都被剪除。
verses.textEnNiv: Wail, you who live in the market district ; all your merchants will be wiped out, all who trade with silver will be destroyed.
verses.textEnEsv: Wail, O inhabitants of the Mortar! For all the traders are no more; all who weigh out silver are cut off.
verses.textEnNkjv: Wail, you inhabitants of Maktesh! For all the merchant people are cut down; All those who handle money are cut off.
verses.textEnNlt: Wail in sorrow, all you who live in the market area, for all the merchants and traders will be destroyed.
verses.textEnNasb: "Wail, you inhabitants of the Mortar, Because all the people of Canaan will be destroyed; All who weigh out silver will be eliminated.
verses.textEn: Wail, you who live in the market district ; all your merchants will be wiped out, all who trade with silver will be destroyed.

verses.textZh: 那时， 我必提灯搜查耶路撒冷， 惩罚那些在罪中陶然自得的人 。 这些人心里说： ‘耶和华必不赐福，也不降祸。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时， 我必提灯搜查耶路撒冷， 惩罚那些在罪中陶然自得的人 。 这些人心里说： ‘耶和华必不赐福，也不降祸。’
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，我必用灯巡查耶路撒冷； 我必惩罚那些如酒在渣滓上澄清的； 他们心里说： 耶和华必不降福，也不降祸。
verses.textEnNiv: At that time I will search Jerusalem with lamps and punish those who are complacent, who are like wine left on its dregs, who think, ‘The Lord will do nothing, either good or bad.’
verses.textEnEsv: At that time I will search Jerusalem with lamps, and I will punish the men who are complacent, those who say in their hearts, ‘The Lord will not do good, nor will he do ill.’
verses.textEnNkjv: "And it shall come to pass at that time That I will search Jerusalem with lamps, And punish the men Who are settled in complacency, Who say in their heart, ‘The Lord will not do good, Nor will He do evil.’
verses.textEnNlt: "I will search with lanterns in Jerusalem’s darkest corners to punish those who sit complacent in their sins. They think the Lord will do nothing to them, either good or bad.
verses.textEnNasb: "And it will come about at that time That I will search Jerusalem with lamps, And I will punish the people Who are stagnant in spirit, Who say in their hearts, ‘The Lord will not do good nor harm!’
verses.textEn: At that time I will search Jerusalem with lamps and punish those who are complacent, who are like wine left on its dregs, who think, ‘The Lord will do nothing, either good or bad.’

verses.textZh: 他们的财宝必成为掠物， 他们的房屋必变为废墟。 他们建造房屋，却不得住在其中； 他们栽植葡萄园，却不得喝所出的酒。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们的财宝必成为掠物， 他们的房屋必变为废墟。 他们建造房屋，却不得住在其中； 他们栽植葡萄园，却不得喝所出的酒。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们的财宝必成为掠物； 他们的房屋必变为荒场。 他们必建造房屋，却不得住在其内； 栽种葡萄园，却不得喝所出的酒。
verses.textEnNiv: Their wealth will be plundered, their houses demolished. Though they build houses, they will not live in them; though they plant vineyards, they will not drink the wine."
verses.textEnEsv: Their goods shall be plundered, and their houses laid waste. Though they build houses, they shall not inhabit them; though they plant vineyards, they shall not drink wine from them."
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore their goods shall become booty, And their houses a desolation; They shall build houses, but not inhabit them; They shall plant vineyards, but not drink their wine."
verses.textEnNlt: So their property will be plundered, their homes will be ransacked. They will build new homes but never live in them. They will plant vineyards but never drink wine from them.
verses.textEnNasb: "Their wealth will become plunder, And their houses desolate; Yes, they will build houses but not inhabit them, And plant vineyards but not drink their wine."
verses.textEn: Their wealth will be plundered, their houses demolished. Though they build houses, they will not live in them; though they plant vineyards, they will not drink the wine."

verses.textZh: 耶和华的大日子临近了， 临近了，来得非常快速。 听！耶和华的日子的声音。 在那日，勇士要哀痛地号叫。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的大日子临近了， 临近了，来得非常快速。 听！耶和华的日子的声音。 在那日，勇士要哀痛地号叫。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的大日临近， 临近而且甚快， 乃是耶和华日子的风声； 勇士必痛痛地哭号。
verses.textEnNiv: The great day of the Lord is near— near and coming quickly. The cry on the day of the Lord is bitter; the Mighty Warrior shouts his battle cry.
verses.textEnEsv: The great day of the Lord is near, near and hastening fast; the sound of the day of the Lord is bitter; the mighty man cries aloud there.
verses.textEnNkjv: The great day of the Lordis near; Itis near and hastens quickly. The noise of the day of the Lord is bitter; There the mighty men shall cry out.
verses.textEnNlt: "That terrible day of the Lord is near. Swiftly it comes— a day of bitter tears, a day when even strong men will cry out.
verses.textEnNasb: The great day of the Lord is near, Near and coming very quickly; Listen, the day of the Lord! In it the warrior cries out bitterly.
verses.textEn: The great day of the Lord is near— near and coming quickly. The cry on the day of the Lord is bitter; the Mighty Warrior shouts his battle cry.

verses.textZh: 那日是忿怒的日子， 是困苦艰难的日子， 是荒废凄凉的日子， 是黑暗幽冥的日子， 是密云漆黑的日子，
verses.textZhCnvs: 那日是忿怒的日子， 是困苦艰难的日子， 是荒废凄凉的日子， 是黑暗幽冥的日子， 是密云漆黑的日子，
verses.textZhCuv: 那日是忿怒的日子， 是急难困苦的日子， 是荒废凄凉的日子， 是黑暗幽冥、密云乌黑的日子，
verses.textEnNiv: That day will be a day of wrath— a day of distress and anguish, a day of trouble and ruin, a day of darkness and gloom, a day of clouds and blackness—
verses.textEnEsv: A day of wrath is that day, a day of distress and anguish, a day of ruin and devastation, a day of darkness and gloom, a day of clouds and thick darkness,
verses.textEnNkjv: That day is a day of wrath, A day of trouble and distress, A day of devastation and desolation, A day of darkness and gloominess, A day of clouds and thick darkness,
verses.textEnNlt: It will be a day when the Lord ’s anger is poured out— a day of terrible distress and anguish, a day of ruin and desolation, a day of darkness and gloom, a day of clouds and blackness,
verses.textEnNasb: That day is a day of anger, A day of trouble and distress, A day of destruction and desolation, A day of darkness and gloom, A day of clouds and thick darkness,
verses.textEn: That day will be a day of wrath— a day of distress and anguish, a day of trouble and ruin, a day of darkness and gloom, a day of clouds and blackness—

verses.textZh: 是吹号吶喊， 要攻打坚城， 进击高耸城楼的日子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 是吹号吶喊， 要攻打坚城， 进击高耸城楼的日子。
verses.textZhCuv: 是吹角呐喊的日子， 要攻击坚固城和高大的城楼。
verses.textEnNiv: a day of trumpet and battle cry against the fortified cities and against the corner towers.
verses.textEnEsv: a day of trumpet blast and battle cry against the fortified cities and against the lofty battlements.
verses.textEnNkjv: A day of trumpet and alarm Against the fortified cities And against the high towers.
verses.textEnNlt: a day of trumpet calls and battle cries. Down go the walled cities and the strongest battlements!
verses.textEnNasb: A day of trumpet and battle cry Against the fortified cities And the high corner towers.
verses.textEn: a day of trumpet and battle cry against the fortified cities and against the corner towers.

verses.textZh: 我要使人受困苦， 以致他们像瞎子行走， 因为他们得罪耶和华。 他们的鲜血必倒出，如倒灰尘一样， 他们的身体必被遗弃像粪土一般。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要使人受困苦， 以致他们像瞎子行走， 因为他们得罪耶和华。 他们的鲜血必倒出，如倒灰尘一样， 他们的身体必被遗弃像粪土一般。
verses.textZhCuv: 我必使灾祸临到人身上， 使他们行走如同瞎眼的， 因为得罪了我。 他们的血必倒出如灰尘； 他们的肉必抛弃如粪土。
verses.textEnNiv: "I will bring such distress on all people that they will grope about like those who are blind, because they have sinned against the Lord . Their blood will be poured out like dust and their entrails like dung.
verses.textEnEsv: I will bring distress on mankind, so that they shall walk like the blind, because they have sinned against the Lord ; their blood shall be poured out like dust, and their flesh like dung.
verses.textEnNkjv: "I will bring distress upon men, And they shall walk like blind men, Because they have sinned against the Lord; Their blood shall be poured out like dust, And their flesh like refuse."
verses.textEnNlt: "Because you have sinned against the Lord , I will make you grope around like the blind. Your blood will be poured into the dust, and your bodies will lie rotting on the ground."
verses.textEnNasb: I will bring distress on mankind So that they will walk like those who are blind, Because they have sinned against the Lord; And their blood will be poured out like dust, And their flesh like dung.
verses.textEn: "I will bring such distress on all people that they will grope about like those who are blind, because they have sinned against the Lord . Their blood will be poured out like dust and their entrails like dung.

verses.textZh: 在耶和华发怒的日子， 他们的金银也不能救他们， 全地都要被他的妒火吞灭； 因为他要彻底毁灭地上所有的居民， 真是可怕的毁灭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在耶和华发怒的日子， 他们的金银也不能救他们， 全地都要被他的妒火吞灭； 因为他要彻底毁灭地上所有的居民， 真是可怕的毁灭。
verses.textZhCuv: 当耶和华发怒的日子， 他们的金银不能救他们； 他的忿怒如火必烧灭全地， 毁灭这地的一切居民，而且大大毁灭。
verses.textEnNiv: Neither their silver nor their gold will be able to save them on the day of the Lord ’s wrath." In the fire of his jealousy the whole earth will be consumed, for he will make a sudden end of all who live on the earth.
verses.textEnEsv: Neither their silver nor their gold shall be able to deliver them on the day of the wrath of the Lord . In the fire of his jealousy, all the earth shall be consumed; for a full and sudden end he will make of all the inhabitants of the earth.
verses.textEnNkjv: Neither their silver nor their gold Shall be able to deliver them In the day of the Lord’s wrath; But the whole land shall be devoured By the fire of His jealousy, For He will make speedy riddance Of all those who dwell in the land.
verses.textEnNlt: Your silver and gold will not save you on that day of the Lord ’s anger. For the whole land will be devoured by the fire of his jealousy. He will make a terrifying end of all the people on earth.
verses.textEnNasb: Neither their silver nor their gold Will be able to save them On the day of the Lord’s anger; And all the earth will be devoured By the fire of His jealousy, For He will make a complete end, Indeed a horrifying one, Of all the inhabitants of the earth.
verses.textEn: Neither their silver nor their gold will be able to save them on the day of the Lord ’s wrath." In the fire of his jealousy the whole earth will be consumed, for he will make a sudden end of all who live on the earth.

verses.textZh: 无耻的国民哪！ 你们要聚集， 要聚集起来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 无耻的国民哪！ 你们要聚集， 要聚集起来。
verses.textZhCuv: 趁命令没有发出， 日子过去如风前的糠， 耶和华的烈怒未临到你们， 他发怒的日子未到以先， 你们应当聚集前来。
verses.textEnNiv: Gather together, gather yourselves together, you shameful nation,
verses.textEnEsv: Gather together, yes, gather, O shameless nation,
verses.textEnNkjv: Gather yourselves together, yes, gather together, O undesirable nation,
verses.textEnNlt: Gather together—yes, gather together, you shameless nation.
verses.textEnNasb: Gather yourselves together, yes, join together, You nation without shame,
verses.textEn: Gather together, gather yourselves together, you shameful nation,

verses.textZh: 趁命令还没有发出， 日子还没有像风前的糠秕一般吹过， 耶和华的烈怒还没有临到你们， 耶和华忿怒的日子还没有临到你们以前， 你们要聚集起来！
verses.textZhCnvs: 趁命令还没有发出， 日子还没有像风前的糠秕一般吹过， 耶和华的烈怒还没有临到你们， 耶和华忿怒的日子还没有临到你们以前， 你们要聚集起来！
verses.textZhCuv: 世上遵守耶和华典章的谦卑人哪， 你们都当寻求耶和华！ 当寻求公义谦卑， 或者在耶和华发怒的日子可以隐藏起来。
verses.textEnNiv: before the decree takes effect and that day passes like windblown chaff, before the Lord ’s fierce anger comes upon you, before the day of the Lord ’s wrath comes upon you.
verses.textEnEsv: before the decree takes effect —before the day passes away like chaff— before there comes upon you the burning anger of the Lord , before there comes upon you the day of the anger of the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: Before the decree is issued, Or the day passes like chaff, Before the Lord’s fierce anger comes upon you, Before the day of the Lord’s anger comes upon you!
verses.textEnNlt: Gather before judgment begins, before your time to repent is blown away like chaff. Act now, before the fierce fury of the Lord falls and the terrible day of the Lord ’s anger begins.
verses.textEnNasb: Before the decree takes effect— The day passes like chaff— Before the burning anger of the Lord comes upon you, Before the day of the Lord’s anger comes upon you.
verses.textEn: before the decree takes effect and that day passes like windblown chaff, before the Lord ’s fierce anger comes upon you, before the day of the Lord ’s wrath comes upon you.

verses.textZh: 地上所有谦卑的人， 就是遵守耶和华典章的人哪！ 你们要寻求耶和华， 你们要寻求公义，寻求谦卑。 在耶和华忿怒的日子， 你们或许得以隐藏起来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 地上所有谦卑的人， 就是遵守耶和华典章的人哪！ 你们要寻求耶和华， 你们要寻求公义，寻求谦卑。 在耶和华忿怒的日子， 你们或许得以隐藏起来。
verses.textZhCuv: 迦萨必致见弃； 亚实基伦必然荒凉。 人在正午必赶出亚实突的民； 以革伦也被拔出根来。
verses.textEnNiv: Seek the Lord , all you humble of the land, you who do what he commands. Seek righteousness, seek humility; perhaps you will be sheltered on the day of the Lord ’s anger.
verses.textEnEsv: Seek the Lord , all you humble of the land, who do his just commands; seek righteousness; seek humility; perhaps you may be hidden on the day of the anger of the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: Seek the Lord, all you meek of the earth, Who have upheld His justice. Seek righteousness, seek humility. It may be that you will be hidden In the day of the Lord’s anger.
verses.textEnNlt: Seek the Lord , all who are humble, and follow his commands. Seek to do what is right and to live humbly. Perhaps even yet the Lord will protect you— protect you from his anger on that day of destruction.
verses.textEnNasb: Seek the Lord, All you humble of the earth Who have practiced His ordinances; Seek righteousness, seek humility. Perhaps you will remain hidden On the day of the Lord’s anger.
verses.textEn: Seek the Lord , all you humble of the land, you who do what he commands. Seek righteousness, seek humility; perhaps you will be sheltered on the day of the Lord ’s anger.

verses.textZh: 因为迦萨必被拋弃， 亚实基伦必成荒场， 亚实突的居民必在晌午被赶走； 以革伦必连根拔起来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为迦萨必被拋弃， 亚实基伦必成荒场， 亚实突的居民必在晌午被赶走； 以革伦必连根拔起来。
verses.textZhCuv: 住沿海之地的基利提族有祸了！ 迦南、非利士人之地啊，耶和华的话与你反对， 说：我必毁灭你，以致无人居住。
verses.textEnNiv: Gaza will be abandoned and Ashkelon left in ruins. At midday Ashdod will be emptied and Ekron uprooted.
verses.textEnEsv: For Gaza shall be deserted, and Ashkelon shall become a desolation; Ashdod’s people shall be driven out at noon, and Ekron shall be uprooted.
verses.textEnNkjv: For Gaza shall be forsaken, And Ashkelon desolate; They shall drive out Ashdod at noonday, And Ekron shall be uprooted.
verses.textEnNlt: Gaza and Ashkelon will be abandoned, Ashdod and Ekron torn down.
verses.textEnNasb: For Gaza will be abandoned, And Ashkelon will become a desolation; The inhabitants of Ashdod will be driven out at noon, And Ekron will be uprooted.
verses.textEn: Gaza will be abandoned and Ashkelon left in ruins. At midday Ashdod will be emptied and Ekron uprooted.

verses.textZh: 住在沿海地带的人， 基列提的国民哪！你们有祸了。 这是耶和华攻击你们的话： "非利士人之地迦南啊！ 我必毁灭你，使你那里没有人居住。
verses.textZhCnvs: 住在沿海地带的人， 基列提的国民哪！你们有祸了。 这是耶和华攻击你们的话： "非利士人之地迦南啊！ 我必毁灭你，使你那里没有人居住。
verses.textZhCuv: 沿海之地要变为草场， 其上有牧人的住处和羊群的圈。
verses.textEnNiv: Woe to you who live by the sea, you Kerethite people; the word of the Lord is against you, Canaan, land of the Philistines. He says, "I will destroy you, and none will be left."
verses.textEnEsv: Woe to you inhabitants of the seacoast, you nation of the Cherethites! The word of the Lord is against you, O Canaan, land of the Philistines; and I will destroy you until no inhabitant is left.
verses.textEnNkjv: Woe to the inhabitants of the seacoast, The nation of the Cherethites! The word of the Lordis against you, O Canaan, land of the Philistines: "I will destroy you; So there shall be no inhabitant."
verses.textEnNlt: And what sorrow awaits you Philistines who live along the coast and in the land of Canaan, for this judgment is against you, too! The Lord will destroy you until not one of you is left.
verses.textEnNasb: Woe to the inhabitants of the seacoast, The nation of the Cherethites! The word of the Lord is against you, Canaan, land of the Philistines; And I will eliminate you So that there will be no inhabitant.
verses.textEn: Woe to you who live by the sea, you Kerethite people; the word of the Lord is against you, Canaan, land of the Philistines. He says, "I will destroy you, and none will be left."

verses.textZh: 沿海的地必成为草场、 牧人的洞穴、 羊群的圈栏。
verses.textZhCnvs: 沿海的地必成为草场、 牧人的洞穴、 羊群的圈栏。
verses.textZhCuv: 这地必为犹大家剩下的人所得； 他们必在那里牧放群羊， 晚上必躺卧在亚实基伦的房屋中； 因为耶和华－他们的神必眷顾他们， 使他们被掳的人归回。
verses.textEnNiv: The land by the sea will become pastures having wells for shepherds and pens for flocks.
verses.textEnEsv: And you, O seacoast, shall be pastures, with meadows for shepherds and folds for flocks.
verses.textEnNkjv: The seacoast shall be pastures, With shelters for shepherds and folds for flocks.
verses.textEnNlt: The Philistine coast will become a wilderness pasture, a place of shepherd camps and enclosures for sheep and goats.
verses.textEnNasb: So the seacoast will become grazing places, With pastures for shepherds and folds for flocks.
verses.textEn: The land by the sea will become pastures having wells for shepherds and pens for flocks.

verses.textZh: 这地必归给犹大家的余民； 他们要在那里放牧， 晚上他们躺卧在亚实基伦的房舍中； 因为耶和华他们的神必眷顾他们， 使他们从被掳之地归回。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 这地必归给犹大家的余民； 他们要在那里放牧， 晚上他们躺卧在亚实基伦的房舍中； 因为耶和华他们的神必眷顾他们， 使他们从被掳之地归回。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我听见摩押人的毁谤和亚扪人的辱骂， 就是毁谤我的百姓，自夸自大， 侵犯他们的境界。
verses.textEnNiv: That land will belong to the remnant of the people of Judah; there they will find pasture. In the evening they will lie down in the houses of Ashkelon. The Lord their God will care for them; he will restore their fortunes.
verses.textEnEsv: The seacoast shall become the possession of the remnant of the house of Judah, on which they shall graze, and in the houses of Ashkelon they shall lie down at evening. For the Lord their God will be mindful of them and restore their fortunes.
verses.textEnNkjv: The coast shall be for the remnant of the house of Judah; They shall feed their flocks there; In the houses of Ashkelon they shall lie down at evening. For the Lord their God will intervene for them, And return their captives.
verses.textEnNlt: The remnant of the tribe of Judah will pasture there. They will rest at night in the abandoned houses in Ashkelon. For the Lord their God will visit his people in kindness and restore their prosperity again.
verses.textEnNasb: And the coast will be For the remnant of the house of Judah, They will drive sheep to pasture on it. In the houses of Ashkelon they will lie down at evening; For the Lord their God will care for them And restore their fortunes.
verses.textEn: That land will belong to the remnant of the people of Judah; there they will find pasture. In the evening they will lie down in the houses of Ashkelon. The Lord their God will care for them; he will restore their fortunes.

verses.textZh: 我听见了摩押人的辱骂之言， 听见了亚扪人的毁谤之语， 他们辱骂我的子民， 又自夸自大侵犯他们的境界。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我听见了摩押人的辱骂之言， 听见了亚扪人的毁谤之语， 他们辱骂我的子民， 又自夸自大侵犯他们的境界。
verses.textZhCuv: 万军之耶和华－以色列的神说： 我指着我的永生起誓： 摩押必像所多玛， 亚扪人必像蛾摩拉， 都变为刺草、盐坑、永远荒废之地。 我百姓所剩下的必掳掠他们； 我国中所余剩的必得着他们的地。
verses.textEnNiv: "I have heard the insults of Moab and the taunts of the Ammonites, who insulted my people and made threats against their land.
verses.textEnEsv: "I have heard the taunts of Moab and the revilings of the Ammonites, how they have taunted my people and made boasts against their territory.
verses.textEnNkjv: "I have heard the reproach of Moab, And the insults of the people of Ammon, With which they have reproached My people, And made arrogant threats against their borders.
verses.textEnNlt: "I have heard the taunts of the Moabites and the insults of the Ammonites, mocking my people and invading their borders.
verses.textEnNasb: "I have heard the taunting of Moab And the abusive speech of the sons of Ammon, With which they have taunted My people And boasted against their territory.
verses.textEn: "I have heard the insults of Moab and the taunts of the Ammonites, who insulted my people and made threats against their land.

verses.textZh: 因此，万军之耶和华 以色列的神说： "我指着我的永生起誓： 摩押人必要像所多玛， 亚扪人必定像蛾摩拉， 成为刺草和盐坑之所， 永远荒凉之地。 我余下的子民必掳掠他们， 我国中所余的要得着他们为业。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，万军之耶和华 以色列的神说： "我指着我的永生起誓： 摩押人必要像所多玛， 亚扪人必定像蛾摩拉， 成为刺草和盐坑之所， 永远荒凉之地。 我余下的子民必掳掠他们， 我国中所余的要得着他们为业。"
verses.textZhCuv: 这事临到他们是因他们骄傲，自夸自大， 毁谤万军之耶和华的百姓。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore, as surely as I live," declares the Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, "surely Moab will become like Sodom, the Ammonites like Gomorrah— a place of weeds and salt pits, a wasteland forever. The remnant of my people will plunder them; the survivors of my nation will inherit their land."
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore, as I live," declares the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel, "Moab shall become like Sodom, and the Ammonites like Gomorrah, a land possessed by nettles and salt pits, and a waste forever. The remnant of my people shall plunder them, and the survivors of my nation shall possess them."
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore, as I live," Says the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel, "Surely Moab shall be like Sodom, And the people of Ammon like Gomorrah— Overrun with weeds and saltpits, And a perpetual desolation. The residue of My people shall plunder them, And the remnant of My people shall possess them."
verses.textEnNlt: Now, as surely as I live," says the Lord of Heaven’s Armies, the God of Israel, "Moab and Ammon will be destroyed— destroyed as completely as Sodom and Gomorrah. Their land will become a place of stinging nettles, salt pits, and eternal desolation. The remnant of my people will plunder them and take their land."
verses.textEnNasb: "Therefore, as I live," declares the Lord of armies, The God of Israel, "Moab will assuredly be like Sodom, And the sons of Ammon like Gomorrah— Ground overgrown with weeds and full of salt mines, And a permanent desolation. The remnant of My people will plunder them, And the remainder of My nation will inherit them."
verses.textEn: Therefore, as surely as I live," declares the Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, "surely Moab will become like Sodom, the Ammonites like Gomorrah— a place of weeds and salt pits, a wasteland forever. The remnant of my people will plunder them; the survivors of my nation will inherit their land."

verses.textZh: 由于他们的狂傲，这事就临到他们；因为他们自夸自大，辱骂万军之耶和华的子民。
verses.textZhCnvs: 由于他们的狂傲，这事就临到他们；因为他们自夸自大，辱骂万军之耶和华的子民。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华必向他们显可畏之威， 因他必叫世上的诸神瘦弱。 列国海岛的居民各在自己的地方敬拜他。
verses.textEnNiv: This is what they will get in return for their pride, for insulting and mocking the people of the Lord Almighty.
verses.textEnEsv: This shall be their lot in return for their pride, because they taunted and boasted against the people of the Lord of hosts.
verses.textEnNkjv: This they shall have for their pride, Because they have reproached and made arrogant threats Against the people of the Lord of hosts.
verses.textEnNlt: They will receive the wages of their pride, for they have scoffed at the people of the Lord of Heaven’s Armies.
verses.textEnNasb: This they will have in return for their arrogance, because they have taunted and boasted against the people of the Lord of armies.
verses.textEn: This is what they will get in return for their pride, for insulting and mocking the people of the Lord Almighty.

verses.textZh: 对于他们，耶和华是可畏惧的，因为他要消灭地上一切神祇；那时，列国海岛上的居民，都各在自己的地方敬拜他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 对于他们，耶和华是可畏惧的，因为他要消灭地上一切神祇；那时，列国海岛上的居民，都各在自己的地方敬拜他。
verses.textZhCuv: 古实人哪，你们必被我的刀所杀。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord will be awesome to them when he destroys all the gods of the earth. Distant nations will bow down to him, all of them in their own lands.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord will be awesome against them; for he will famish all the gods of the earth, and to him shall bow down, each in its place, all the lands of the nations.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lordwillbe awesome to them, For He will reduce to nothing all the gods of the earth; People shall worship Him, Each one from his place, Indeed all the shores of the nations.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord will terrify them as he destroys all the gods in the land. Then nations around the world will worship the Lord , each in their own land.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord will be terrifying to them, for He will starve all the gods of the earth; and all the coastlands of the nations will bow down to Him, everyone from his own place.
verses.textEn: The Lord will be awesome to them when he destroys all the gods of the earth. Distant nations will bow down to him, all of them in their own lands.

verses.textZh: 古实人哪！ 你们也必被我的刀剑所杀。
verses.textZhCnvs: 古实人哪！ 你们也必被我的刀剑所杀。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华必伸手攻击北方，毁灭亚述， 使尼尼微荒凉，又干旱如旷野。
verses.textEnNiv: "You Cushites, too, will be slain by my sword."
verses.textEnEsv: You also, O Cushites, shall be slain by my sword.
verses.textEnNkjv: "You Ethiopians also, You shall be slain by My sword."
verses.textEnNlt: "You Ethiopians will also be slaughtered by my sword," says the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: "You also, Ethiopians, will be slain by My sword."
verses.textEn: "You Cushites, too, will be slain by my sword."

verses.textZh: 耶和华必伸手攻击北方， 毁灭亚述， 使尼尼微变成荒场， 干旱像旷野。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华必伸手攻击北方， 毁灭亚述， 使尼尼微变成荒场， 干旱像旷野。
verses.textZhCuv: 群畜，就是各国 的走兽必卧在其中； 鹈鹕和箭猪要宿在柱顶上。 在窗户内有鸣叫的声音； 门槛都必毁坏， 香柏木已经露出。
verses.textEnNiv: He will stretch out his hand against the north and destroy Assyria, leaving Nineveh utterly desolate and dry as the desert.
verses.textEnEsv: And he will stretch out his hand against the north and destroy Assyria, and he will make Nineveh a desolation, a dry waste like the desert.
verses.textEnNkjv: And He will stretch out His hand against the north, Destroy Assyria, And make Nineveh a desolation, As dry as the wilderness.
verses.textEnNlt: And the Lord will strike the lands of the north with his fist, destroying the land of Assyria. He will make its great capital, Nineveh, a desolate wasteland, parched like a desert.
verses.textEnNasb: And He will stretch out His hand against the north And eliminate Assyria, And He will make Nineveh a desolation, Parched like the wilderness.
verses.textEn: He will stretch out his hand against the north and destroy Assyria, leaving Nineveh utterly desolate and dry as the desert.

verses.textZh: 群畜和各类的走兽必躺卧在其中； 鹈鹕和箭猪栖宿在柱顶上； 窗内有鸣叫的声音， 门槛上必有荒凉； 因为香柏木都要暴露出来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 群畜和各类的走兽必躺卧在其中； 鹈鹕和箭猪栖宿在柱顶上； 窗内有鸣叫的声音， 门槛上必有荒凉； 因为香柏木都要暴露出来。
verses.textZhCuv: 这是素来欢乐安然居住的城， 心里说：惟有我，除我以外再没有别的； 现在何竟荒凉成为野兽躺卧之处！ 凡经过的人都必摇手嗤笑她。
verses.textEnNiv: Flocks and herds will lie down there, creatures of every kind. The desert owl and the screech owl will roost on her columns. Their hooting will echo through the windows, rubble will fill the doorways, the beams of cedar will be exposed.
verses.textEnEsv: Herds shall lie down in her midst, all kinds of beasts; even the owl and the hedgehog shall lodge in her capitals; a voice shall hoot in the window; devastation will be on the threshold; for her cedar work will be laid bare.
verses.textEnNkjv: The herds shall lie down in her midst, Every beast of the nation. Both the pelican and the bittern Shall lodge on the capitals of her pillars; Their voice shall sing in the windows; Desolation shallbe at the threshold; For He will lay bare the cedar work.
verses.textEnNlt: The proud city will become a pasture for flocks and herds, and all sorts of wild animals will settle there. The desert owl and screech owl will roost on its ruined columns, their calls echoing through the gaping windows. Rubble will block all the doorways, and the cedar paneling will be exposed to the weather.
verses.textEnNasb: Flocks will lie down in her midst, All animals that range in herds; Both the pelican and the hedgehog Will spend their nights in the tops of her pillars; Birds will sing in the window, Devastation will be on the threshold; For He has uncovered the cedar work.
verses.textEn: Flocks and herds will lie down there, creatures of every kind. The desert owl and the screech owl will roost on her columns. Their hooting will echo through the windows, rubble will fill the doorways, the beams of cedar will be exposed.

verses.textZh: 这就是那欢乐安居之城， 她心里曾说： "只有我，除我以外，再没有别的了。" 现在怎么竟成了荒场、 走兽躺卧之处呢！ 凡从那里经过的， 都必舞手嗤笑。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这就是那欢乐安居之城， 她心里曾说： "只有我，除我以外，再没有别的了。" 现在怎么竟成了荒场、 走兽躺卧之处呢！ 凡从那里经过的， 都必舞手嗤笑。
verses.textZhCuv: 这就是那欢乐安居之城， 她心里曾说： "只有我，除我以外，再没有别的了。" 现在怎么竟成了荒场、 走兽躺卧之处呢！ 凡从那里经过的， 都必舞手嗤笑。
verses.textEnNiv: This is the city of revelry that lived in safety. She said to herself, "I am the one! And there is none besides me." What a ruin she has become, a lair for wild beasts! All who pass by her scoff and shake their fists.
verses.textEnEsv: This is the exultant city that lived securely, that said in her heart, "I am, and there is no one else." What a desolation she has become, a lair for wild beasts! Everyone who passes by her hisses and shakes his fist.
verses.textEnNkjv: This is the rejoicing city That dwelt securely, That said in her heart, "I amit, and thereis none besides me." How has she become a desolation, A place for beasts to lie down! Everyone who passes by her Shall hiss and shake his fist.
verses.textEnNlt: This is the boisterous city, once so secure. "I am the greatest!" it boasted. "No other city can compare with me!" But now, look how it has become an utter ruin, a haven for wild animals. Everyone passing by will laugh in derision and shake a defiant fist.
verses.textEnNasb: This is the presumptuous city That dwells securely, Who says in her heart, "I am, and there is no one besides me." How she has become a desolation, A resting place for animals! Everyone who passes by her will hiss And wave his hand in contempt.
verses.textEn: This is the city of revelry that lived in safety. She said to herself, "I am the one! And there is none besides me." What a ruin she has become, a lair for wild beasts! All who pass by her scoff and shake their fists.

verses.textZh: 这叛逆、污秽、欺压人的城有祸了！
verses.textZhCnvs: 这叛逆、污秽、欺压人的城有祸了！
verses.textZhCuv: 这悖逆、污秽、欺压的城有祸了！
verses.textEnNiv: Woe to the city of oppressors, rebellious and defiled!
verses.textEnEsv: Woe to her who is rebellious and defiled, the oppressing city!
verses.textEnNkjv: Woe to her who is rebellious and polluted, To the oppressing city!
verses.textEnNlt: What sorrow awaits rebellious, polluted Jerusalem, the city of violence and crime!
verses.textEnNasb: Woe to her who is rebellious and defiled, The oppressive city!
verses.textEn: Woe to the city of oppressors, rebellious and defiled!

verses.textZh: 她不听话， 也不受管教； 她不倚靠耶和华， 也不亲近她的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 她不听话， 也不受管教； 她不倚靠耶和华， 也不亲近她的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 她不听从命令，不领受训诲， 不倚靠耶和华， 不亲近她的神。
verses.textEnNiv: She obeys no one, she accepts no correction. She does not trust in the Lord , she does not draw near to her God.
verses.textEnEsv: She listens to no voice; she accepts no correction. She does not trust in the Lord ; she does not draw near to her God.
verses.textEnNkjv: She has not obeyed His voice, She has not received correction; She has not trusted in the Lord, She has not drawn near to her God.
verses.textEnNlt: No one can tell it anything; it refuses all correction. It does not trust in the Lord or draw near to its God.
verses.textEnNasb: She obeyed no voice, She accepted no discipline. She did not trust in the Lord, She did not approach her God.
verses.textEn: She obeys no one, she accepts no correction. She does not trust in the Lord , she does not draw near to her God.

verses.textZh: 城中的领袖都是咆哮的狮子， 城中的审判官是夜间的豺狼， 甚么都不留到早晨。
verses.textZhCnvs: 城中的领袖都是咆哮的狮子， 城中的审判官是夜间的豺狼， 甚么都不留到早晨。
verses.textZhCuv: 她中间的首领是咆哮的狮子； 她的审判官是晚上的豺狼， 一点食物也不留到早晨。
verses.textEnNiv: Her officials within her are roaring lions; her rulers are evening wolves, who leave nothing for the morning.
verses.textEnEsv: Her officials within her are roaring lions; her judges are evening wolves that leave nothing till the morning.
verses.textEnNkjv: Her princes in her midst are roaring lions; Her judges are evening wolves That leave not a bone till morning.
verses.textEnNlt: Its leaders are like roaring lions hunting for their victims. Its judges are like ravenous wolves at evening time, who by dawn have left no trace of their prey.
verses.textEnNasb: Her leaders within her are roaring lions, Her judges are wolves at evening; They have no bones to gnaw in the morning.
verses.textEn: Her officials within her are roaring lions; her rulers are evening wolves, who leave nothing for the morning.

verses.textZh: 城中的先知都是轻浮诡诈的人； 城中的祭司亵渎圣物， 违犯律法。
verses.textZhCnvs: 城中的先知都是轻浮诡诈的人； 城中的祭司亵渎圣物， 违犯律法。
verses.textZhCuv: 她的先知是虚浮诡诈的人； 她的祭司亵渎圣所， 强解律法。
verses.textEnNiv: Her prophets are unprincipled; they are treacherous people. Her priests profane the sanctuary and do violence to the law.
verses.textEnEsv: Her prophets are fickle, treacherous men; her priests profane what is holy; they do violence to the law.
verses.textEnNkjv: Her prophets are insolent, treacherous people; Her priests have polluted the sanctuary, They have done violence to the law.
verses.textEnNlt: Its prophets are arrogant liars seeking their own gain. Its priests defile the Temple by disobeying God’s instructions.
verses.textEnNasb: Her prophets are insolent, treacherous men; Her priests have profaned the sanctuary. They have done violence to the Law.
verses.textEn: Her prophets are unprincipled; they are treacherous people. Her priests profane the sanctuary and do violence to the law.

verses.textZh: 耶和华在城中是公义的， 决不行不义的事； 他每日早晨都显明公正， 永不止息。 不公义的人却不知廉耻。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华在城中是公义的， 决不行不义的事； 他每日早晨都显明公正， 永不止息。 不公义的人却不知廉耻。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华在她中间是公义的， 断不做非义的事， 每早晨显明他的公义，无日不然； 只是不义的人不知羞耻。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord within her is righteous; he does no wrong. Morning by morning he dispenses his justice, and every new day he does not fail, yet the unrighteous know no shame.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord within her is righteous; he does no injustice; every morning he shows forth his justice; each dawn he does not fail; but the unjust knows no shame.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lordis righteous in her midst, He will do no unrighteousness. Every morning He brings His justice to light; He never fails, But the unjust knows no shame.
verses.textEnNlt: But the Lord is still there in the city, and he does no wrong. Day by day he hands down justice, and he does not fail. But the wicked know no shame.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord is righteous within her; He will do no injustice. Every morning He brings His justice to light; He does not fail. But the criminal knows no shame.
verses.textEn: The Lord within her is righteous; he does no wrong. Morning by morning he dispenses his justice, and every new day he does not fail, yet the unrighteous know no shame.

verses.textZh: 我耶和华已经剪除列国， 他们的城楼被毁； 我已经使他们的街道荒凉， 以致杳无人迹； 他们的城市荒废，以致无人存留，无人居住。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我耶和华已经剪除列国， 他们的城楼被毁； 我已经使他们的街道荒凉， 以致杳无人迹； 他们的城市荒废，以致无人存留，无人居住。
verses.textZhCuv: 我－耶和华已经除灭列国的民； 他们的城楼毁坏。 我使他们的街道荒凉，以致无人经过； 他们的城邑毁灭，以致无人， 也无居民。
verses.textEnNiv: "I have destroyed nations; their strongholds are demolished. I have left their streets deserted, with no one passing through. Their cities are laid waste; they are deserted and empty.
verses.textEnEsv: "I have cut off nations; their battlements are in ruins; I have laid waste their streets so that no one walks in them; their cities have been made desolate, without a man, without an inhabitant.
verses.textEnNkjv: "I have cut off nations, Their fortresses are devastated; I have made their streets desolate, With none passing by. Their cities are destroyed; Thereis no one, no inhabitant.
verses.textEnNlt: "I have wiped out many nations, devastating their fortress walls and towers. Their streets are now deserted; their cities lie in silent ruin. There are no survivors— none at all.
verses.textEnNasb: "I have eliminated nations; Their corner towers are deserted. I have laid waste their streets, With no one passing by; Their cities have been laid waste, Without a person, without an inhabitant.
verses.textEn: "I have destroyed nations; their strongholds are demolished. I have left their streets deserted, with no one passing through. Their cities are laid waste; they are deserted and empty.

verses.textZh: 我说："她定要敬畏我， 接受管教。" 这样，她的住所 必不会照着我原定对她的惩罚被剪除。 可是他们殷勤行恶， 败坏了自己一切所作的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我说："她定要敬畏我， 接受管教。" 这样，她的住所 必不会照着我原定对她的惩罚被剪除。 可是他们殷勤行恶， 败坏了自己一切所作的。
verses.textZhCuv: 我说：你只要敬畏我，领受训诲； 如此，你的住处不致照我所拟定的除灭。 只是你们从早起来就在一切事上败坏自己。
verses.textEnNiv: Of Jerusalem I thought, ‘Surely you will fear me and accept correction!’ Then her place of refuge would not be destroyed, nor all my punishments come upon her. But they were still eager to act corruptly in all they did.
verses.textEnEsv: I said, ‘Surely you will fear me; you will accept correction. Then your dwelling would not be cut off according to all that I have appointed against you.’ But all the more they were eager to make all their deeds corrupt.
verses.textEnNkjv: I said, ‘Surely you will fear Me, You will receive instruction’— So that her dwelling would not be cut off, Despite everything for which I punished her. But they rose early and corrupted all their deeds.
verses.textEnNlt: I thought, ‘Surely they will have reverence for me now! Surely they will listen to my warnings. Then I won’t need to strike again, destroying their homes.’ But no, they get up early to continue their evil deeds.
verses.textEnNasb: "I said, ‘You will certainly revere Me, You will accept discipline.’ So her dwelling will not be eliminated In accordance with everything that I have stipulated for her. Instead, they were eager to corrupt all their deeds.
verses.textEn: Of Jerusalem I thought, ‘Surely you will fear me and accept correction!’ Then her place of refuge would not be destroyed, nor all my punishments come upon her. But they were still eager to act corruptly in all they did.

verses.textZh: 耶和华说："因此，你们要等候我， 等候我起来指证 的日子， 我已经决定集合万邦， 召聚列国， 把我的盛怒， 就是我的一切烈怒，都倾倒在他们身上； 因为全地都必被我的妒火吞灭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华说："因此，你们要等候我， 等候我起来指证 的日子， 我已经决定集合万邦， 召聚列国， 把我的盛怒， 就是我的一切烈怒，都倾倒在他们身上； 因为全地都必被我的妒火吞灭。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说：你们要等候我， 直到我兴起掳掠的日子； 因为我已定意招聚列国，聚集列邦， 将我的恼怒－就是我的烈怒都倾在她们身上。 我的忿怒如火，必烧灭全地。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore wait for me," declares the Lord , "for the day I will stand up to testify. I have decided to assemble the nations, to gather the kingdoms and to pour out my wrath on them— all my fierce anger. The whole world will be consumed by the fire of my jealous anger.
verses.textEnEsv: "Therefore wait for me," declares the Lord , "for the day when I rise up to seize the prey. For my decision is to gather nations, to assemble kingdoms, to pour out upon them my indignation, all my burning anger; for in the fire of my jealousy all the earth shall be consumed.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Therefore wait for Me," says the Lord, "Until the day I rise up for plunder; My determination is to gather the nations To My assembly of kingdoms, To pour on them My indignation, All My fierce anger; All the earth shall be devoured With the fire of My jealousy.
verses.textEnNlt: Therefore, be patient," says the Lord . "Soon I will stand and accuse these evil nations. For I have decided to gather the kingdoms of the earth and pour out my fiercest anger and fury on them. All the earth will be devoured by the fire of my jealousy.
verses.textEnNasb: "Therefore wait for Me," declares the Lord, "For the day when I rise up as a witness. Indeed, My decision is to gather nations, To assemble kingdoms, To pour out on them My indignation, All My burning anger; For all the earth will be devoured By the fire of My zeal.
verses.textEn: Therefore wait for me," declares the Lord , "for the day I will stand up to testify. I have decided to assemble the nations, to gather the kingdoms and to pour out my wrath on them— all my fierce anger. The whole world will be consumed by the fire of my jealous anger.

verses.textZh: 那时我要使万民有洁净的嘴唇， 他们全都可以呼求耶和华的名， 同心合意事奉耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时我要使万民有洁净的嘴唇， 他们全都可以呼求耶和华的名， 同心合意事奉耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，我必使万民用清洁的言语 好求告我－耶和华的名， 同心合意地事奉我。
verses.textEnNiv: "Then I will purify the lips of the peoples, that all of them may call on the name of the Lord and serve him shoulder to shoulder.
verses.textEnEsv: "For at that time I will change the speech of the peoples to a pure speech, that all of them may call upon the name of the Lord and serve him with one accord.
verses.textEnNkjv: "For then I will restore to the peoples a pure language, That they all may call on the name of the Lord, To serve Him with one accord.
verses.textEnNlt: "Then I will purify the speech of all people, so that everyone can worship the Lord together.
verses.textEnNasb: "For then I will restore to the peoples pure lips, So that all of them may call on the name of the Lord, To serve Him shoulder to shoulder.
verses.textEn: "Then I will purify the lips of the peoples, that all of them may call on the name of the Lord and serve him shoulder to shoulder.

verses.textZh: 敬拜我的人，就是我所分散的人， 必从古实河外而来， 给我献上礼物。
verses.textZhCnvs: 敬拜我的人，就是我所分散的人， 必从古实河外而来， 给我献上礼物。
verses.textZhCuv: 祈祷我的，就是我所分散的民 ， 必从古实河外来，给我献供物。
verses.textEnNiv: From beyond the rivers of Cush my worshipers, my scattered people, will bring me offerings.
verses.textEnEsv: From beyond the rivers of Cush my worshipers, the daughter of my dispersed ones, shall bring my offering.
verses.textEnNkjv: From beyond the rivers of Ethiopia My worshipers, The daughter of My dispersed ones, Shall bring My offering.
verses.textEnNlt: My scattered people who live beyond the rivers of Ethiopia will come to present their offerings.
verses.textEnNasb: "From beyond the rivers of Ethiopia My worshipers, My dispersed ones, Will bring My offerings.
verses.textEn: From beyond the rivers of Cush my worshipers, my scattered people, will bring me offerings.

verses.textZh: 到了那日， 你必不因你背叛我所作的一切感到羞愧， 因为那时我必从你中间 除掉那些自高自大的人。 在我的圣山上， 你必不再高傲。
verses.textZhCnvs: 到了那日， 你必不因你背叛我所作的一切感到羞愧， 因为那时我必从你中间 除掉那些自高自大的人。 在我的圣山上， 你必不再高傲。
verses.textZhCuv: 当那日，你必不因你一切得罪我的事自觉羞愧； 因为那时我必从你中间除掉矜夸高傲之辈， 你也不再于我的圣山狂傲。
verses.textEnNiv: On that day you, Jerusalem, will not be put to shame for all the wrongs you have done to me, because I will remove from you your arrogant boasters. Never again will you be haughty on my holy hill.
verses.textEnEsv: "On that day you shall not be put to shame because of the deeds by which you have rebelled against me; for then I will remove from your midst your proudly exultant ones, and you shall no longer be haughty in my holy mountain.
verses.textEnNkjv: In that day you shall not be shamed for any of your deeds In which you transgress against Me; For then I will take away from your midst Those who rejoice in your pride, And you shall no longer be haughty In My holy mountain.
verses.textEnNlt: On that day you will no longer need to be ashamed, for you will no longer be rebels against me. I will remove all proud and arrogant people from among you. There will be no more haughtiness on my holy mountain.
verses.textEnNasb: "On that day you will feel no shame Because of all your deeds By which you have rebelled against Me; For then I will remove from your midst Your proud, arrogant ones, And you will never again be haughty On My holy mountain.
verses.textEn: On that day you, Jerusalem, will not be put to shame for all the wrongs you have done to me, because I will remove from you your arrogant boasters. Never again will you be haughty on my holy hill.

verses.textZh: 但我要在你中间 留下谦虚卑微的人； 他们必投靠耶和华的名。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但我要在你中间 留下谦虚卑微的人； 他们必投靠耶和华的名。
verses.textZhCuv: 我却要在你中间留下困苦贫寒的民； 他们必投靠我－耶和华的名。
verses.textEnNiv: But I will leave within you the meek and humble. The remnant of Israel will trust in the name of the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: But I will leave in your midst a people humble and lowly. They shall seek refuge in the name of the Lord ,
verses.textEnNkjv: I will leave in your midst A meek and humble people, And they shall trust in the name of the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: Those who are left will be the lowly and humble, for it is they who trust in the name of the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: "But I will leave among you A humble and lowly people, And they will take refuge in the name of the Lord.
verses.textEn: But I will leave within you the meek and humble. The remnant of Israel will trust in the name of the Lord .

verses.textZh: 以色列的余民必不再行不义， 也必不说谎； 他们的口里也没有诡诈的舌头。 他们吃喝躺卧， 没有人惊吓他们。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列的余民必不再行不义， 也必不说谎； 他们的口里也没有诡诈的舌头。 他们吃喝躺卧， 没有人惊吓他们。"
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列所剩下的人必不作罪孽， 不说谎言，口中也没有诡诈的舌头； 而且吃喝躺卧，无人惊吓。
verses.textEnNiv: They will do no wrong; they will tell no lies. A deceitful tongue will not be found in their mouths. They will eat and lie down and no one will make them afraid."
verses.textEnEsv: those who are left in Israel; they shall do no injustice and speak no lies, nor shall there be found in their mouth a deceitful tongue. For they shall graze and lie down, and none shall make them afraid."
verses.textEnNkjv: The remnant of Israel shall do no unrighteousness And speak no lies, Nor shall a deceitful tongue be found in their mouth; For they shall feed their flocks and lie down, And no one shall make them afraid."
verses.textEnNlt: The remnant of Israel will do no wrong; they will never tell lies or deceive one another. They will eat and sleep in safety, and no one will make them afraid."
verses.textEnNasb: "The remnant of Israel will do no wrong And tell no lies, Nor will a deceitful tongue Be found in their mouths; For they will feed and lie down With no one to frighten them."
verses.textEn: They will do no wrong; they will tell no lies. A deceitful tongue will not be found in their mouths. They will eat and lie down and no one will make them afraid."

verses.textZh: 锡安的居民 哪！你们要高歌。 以色列啊！你们要欢呼。 耶路撒冷的居民哪！你们要满心欢喜快乐。
verses.textZhCnvs: 锡安的居民 哪！你们要高歌。 以色列啊！你们要欢呼。 耶路撒冷的居民哪！你们要满心欢喜快乐。
verses.textZhCuv: 锡安的民哪，应当歌唱！ 以色列啊，应当欢呼！ 耶路撒冷的民哪，应当满心欢喜快乐！
verses.textEnNiv: Sing, Daughter Zion; shout aloud, Israel! Be glad and rejoice with all your heart, Daughter Jerusalem!
verses.textEnEsv: Sing aloud, O daughter of Zion; shout, O Israel! Rejoice and exult with all your heart, O daughter of Jerusalem!
verses.textEnNkjv: Sing, O daughter of Zion! Shout, O Israel! Be glad and rejoice with all your heart, O daughter of Jerusalem!
verses.textEnNlt: Sing, O daughter of Zion; shout aloud, O Israel! Be glad and rejoice with all your heart, O daughter of Jerusalem!
verses.textEnNasb: Shout for joy, daughter of Zion! Shout in triumph, Israel! Rejoice and triumph with all your heart, Daughter of Jerusalem!
verses.textEn: Sing, Daughter Zion; shout aloud, Israel! Be glad and rejoice with all your heart, Daughter Jerusalem!

verses.textZh: 耶和华已经除去你们的刑罚， 赶走你们的仇敌。 以色列的王，耶和华在你们中间， 你们必不再惧怕灾祸。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华已经除去你们的刑罚， 赶走你们的仇敌。 以色列的王，耶和华在你们中间， 你们必不再惧怕灾祸。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华已经除去你的刑罚， 赶出你的仇敌。 以色列的王－耶和华在你中间； 你必不再惧怕灾祸。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord has taken away your punishment, he has turned back your enemy. The Lord , the King of Israel, is with you; never again will you fear any harm.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord has taken away the judgments against you; he has cleared away your enemies. The King of Israel, the Lord , is in your midst; you shall never again fear evil.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord has taken away your judgments, He has cast out your enemy. The King of Israel, the Lord, is in your midst; You shall see disaster no more.
verses.textEnNlt: For the Lord will remove his hand of judgment and will disperse the armies of your enemy. And the Lord himself, the King of Israel, will live among you! At last your troubles will be over, and you will never again fear disaster.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord has taken away His judgments against you, He has cleared away your enemies. The King of Israel, the Lord, is in your midst; You will no longer fear disaster.
verses.textEn: The Lord has taken away your punishment, he has turned back your enemy. The Lord , the King of Israel, is with you; never again will you fear any harm.

verses.textZh: 到了那日， 必有人对耶路撒冷说： "锡安哪！不要惧怕； 你的手不要下垂。
verses.textZhCnvs: 到了那日， 必有人对耶路撒冷说： "锡安哪！不要惧怕； 你的手不要下垂。
verses.textZhCuv: 当那日，必有话向耶路撒冷说： 不要惧怕！锡安哪； 不要手软！
verses.textEnNiv: On that day they will say to Jerusalem, "Do not fear, Zion; do not let your hands hang limp.
verses.textEnEsv: On that day it shall be said to Jerusalem: "Fear not, O Zion; let not your hands grow weak.
verses.textEnNkjv: In that day it shall be said to Jerusalem: "Do not fear; Zion, let not your hands be weak.
verses.textEnNlt: On that day the announcement to Jerusalem will be, "Cheer up, Zion! Don’t be afraid!
verses.textEnNasb: On that day it will be said to Jerusalem: "Do not be afraid, Zion; Do not let your hands fall limp.
verses.textEn: On that day they will say to Jerusalem, "Do not fear, Zion; do not let your hands hang limp.

verses.textZh: 耶和华你的神在你中间， 他是施行拯救的大能者， 必因你欢欣快乐， 必默然爱你， 而且必因你喜乐欢唱。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华你的神在你中间， 他是施行拯救的大能者， 必因你欢欣快乐， 必默然爱你， 而且必因你喜乐欢唱。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华－你的神是施行拯救、 大有能力的主。 他在你中间必因你欢欣喜乐， 默然爱你，且因你喜乐而欢呼。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord your God is with you, the Mighty Warrior who saves. He will take great delight in you; in his love he will no longer rebuke you, but will rejoice over you with singing."
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord your God is in your midst, a mighty one who will save; he will rejoice over you with gladness; he will quiet you by his love; he will exult over you with loud singing.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord your God in your midst, The Mighty One, will save; He will rejoice over you with gladness, He will quiet you with His love, He will rejoice over you with singing."
verses.textEnNlt: For the Lord your God is living among you. He is a mighty savior. He will take delight in you with gladness. With his love, he will calm all your fears. He will rejoice over you with joyful songs."
verses.textEnNasb: "The Lord your God is in your midst, A victorious warrior. He will rejoice over you with joy, He will be quiet in His love, He will rejoice over you with shouts of joy.
verses.textEn: The Lord your God is with you, the Mighty Warrior who saves. He will take great delight in you; in his love he will no longer rebuke you, but will rejoice over you with singing."

verses.textZh: "那些属你，为了切慕大会而忧愁的人， 他们担当了羞辱； 我必招聚他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: "那些属你，为了切慕大会而忧愁的人， 他们担当了羞辱； 我必招聚他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 那些属你、为无大会愁烦、 因你担当羞辱的，我必聚集他们。
verses.textEnNiv: "I will remove from you all who mourn over the loss of your appointed festivals, which is a burden and reproach for you.
verses.textEnEsv: I will gather those of you who mourn for the festival, so that you will no longer suffer reproach.
verses.textEnNkjv: "I will gather those who sorrow over the appointed assembly, Who are among you, Towhom its reproach is a burden.
verses.textEnNlt: "I will gather you who mourn for the appointed festivals; you will be disgraced no more.
verses.textEnNasb: "I will gather those who are worried about the appointed feasts— They came from you, Zion; The disgrace of exile is a burden on them.
verses.textEn: "I will remove from you all who mourn over the loss of your appointed festivals, which is a burden and reproach for you.

verses.textZh: 看哪！那时我必对付一切苦待你的人； 我必拯救那些瘸腿的， 聚集那些被赶散的； 在全地受羞辱的， 我必使他们得称赞，有名声。
verses.textZhCnvs: 看哪！那时我必对付一切苦待你的人； 我必拯救那些瘸腿的， 聚集那些被赶散的； 在全地受羞辱的， 我必使他们得称赞，有名声。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，我必罚办一切苦待你的人， 又拯救你瘸腿的，聚集你被赶出的。 那些在全地受羞辱的， 我必使他们得称赞，有名声。
verses.textEnNiv: At that time I will deal with all who oppressed you. I will rescue the lame; I will gather the exiles. I will give them praise and honor in every land where they have suffered shame.
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, at that time I will deal with all your oppressors. And I will save the lame and gather the outcast, and I will change their shame into praise and renown in all the earth.
verses.textEnNkjv: Behold, at that time I will deal with all who afflict you; I will save the lame, And gather those who were driven out; I will appoint them for praise and fame In every land where they were put to shame.
verses.textEnNlt: And I will deal severely with all who have oppressed you. I will save the weak and helpless ones; I will bring together those who were chased away. I will give glory and fame to my former exiles, wherever they have been mocked and shamed.
verses.textEnNasb: "Behold, I am going to deal at that time With all your oppressors; I will save those who limp And gather the scattered, And I will turn their shame into praise and fame In all the earth.
verses.textEn: At that time I will deal with all who oppressed you. I will rescue the lame; I will gather the exiles. I will give them praise and honor in every land where they have suffered shame.

verses.textZh: 那时我必把你们领回， 那时我必把你们齐集； 我使你们被掳的人归回的时候， 必在你们眼前， 叫你们在地上的万民中得称赞， 有名声。" 这是耶和华说的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时我必把你们领回， 那时我必把你们齐集； 我使你们被掳的人归回的时候， 必在你们眼前， 叫你们在地上的万民中得称赞， 有名声。" 这是耶和华说的。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，我必领你们进来，聚集你们； 我使你们被掳之人归回的时候， 就必使你们在地上的万民中有名声，得称赞。 这是耶和华说的。
verses.textEnNiv: At that time I will gather you; at that time I will bring you home. I will give you honor and praise among all the peoples of the earth when I restore your fortunes before your very eyes," says the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: At that time I will bring you in, at the time when I gather you together; for I will make you renowned and praised among all the peoples of the earth, when I restore your fortunes before your eyes," says the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: At that time I will bring you back, Even at the time I gather you; For I will give you fame and praise Among all the peoples of the earth, When I return your captives before your eyes," Says the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: On that day I will gather you together and bring you home again. I will give you a good name, a name of distinction, among all the nations of the earth, as I restore your fortunes before their very eyes. I, the Lord , have spoken!"
verses.textEnNasb: "At that time I will bring you in, Even at the time when I gather you together; Indeed, I will make you famous and praiseworthy Among all the peoples of the earth, When I restore your fortunes before your eyes," Says the Lord.
verses.textEn: At that time I will gather you; at that time I will bring you home. I will give you honor and praise among all the peoples of the earth when I restore your fortunes before your very eyes," says the Lord .
